Event · Advanced

Bataan Memorial Death March

A major remembrance march across the high desert of New Mexico, with civilian and military entry categories.

United States · 20 March 2027 · full and shorter routes

Organiser information checked 24 November 2026. Dates and rules can change.

Why people take part

The march at White Sands Missile Range commemorates those who endured the Bataan Death March during the Second World War. It brings together civilians and military participants; the purpose goes beyond finishing a distance.

Choose a category

The organiser’s FAQ describes a light category without a pack and a heavy category with a 35 lb (about 15.9 kg) pack including its frame. The FAQ lists 26.2 and 14.2 miles; another organiser page gives different distances. Confirm the actual 2027 route and allowed ballast before booking.

Prepare for the desert

  1. Build time on your feet on uneven and sandy ground before attempting a long loaded route.
  2. Practise with the shoes, pack and food you intend to use; account for heat, altitude, wind and slower progress on loose surfaces.
  3. Plan transport, access to the installation, the actual cutoff and the organiser’s medical/support arrangements.

Finish with something left

Choose a category you can sustain without a last-minute jump in training load. Take worsening symptoms seriously and follow staff instructions. The commemoration matters more than a pace target.
